note_tweet.text:
Sorry but the data and facts continue to prove you wrong. Xai remains profitable despite your ignorance. 

On November 1, 2026, Musk replied to users hitting weekly limits early with: “The cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue.” Grok Bot is the always-on agent that runs on a persistent virtual computer and executes multi-step tasks; it consumes far more compute than regular chat. It is bundled into The X Subscription starting at the Premium tier (~$30/month; higher tiers like Super at $100 and Ultra at $200 offer larger shared weekly usage pools). Growth was rapid (~800,000 paid weekly users by early October), but heavy agentic use can cost more in inference/compute than the subscription fee covers. The response is tighter limits (or adjusted allocations) to restore sustainable unit economics, with suggestions to upgrade plans. It is not framed as a company-wide loss.

In short: the Bot product currently has challenging marginal economics for intensive users under existing pricing and shared pools, which is being managed via limits. The overall SI segment is profitable on an operating basis in the latest quarter amid rapid growth and large ongoing infrastructure investment. No public breakdown isolates Grok Bot’s exact revenue versus cost.

Teamily is a human+agent social platform: multi-agent teams live as first-class members in shared group chats/DMs with unified living memory and built-in studios that turn talk into slides/docs/web apps. Vision is full Agentic Internet / AaaS.

Grok Bot: your named always-on teammates on a shared cloud computer (browser/files/terminal). They sign into tools, run routines you demonstrate, and coordinate.

Dots (OpenAI): personal always-on agent with its own cloud computer + 4k app plugins. Proactive, preference-learning; currently one primary Dot (teams later). Strong individual execution via ChatGPT/Slack/Teams.

Cue (Manus): personal agents with real identity—own email, phone, wallet, computer. Handle calls, payments, errands; agents can group-chat.

Teamily prioritizes multi-human multi-agent collab in one context-aware space. The others emphasize autonomous computer-use agents (personal or team).
